VitalConnect

VitalPatch® RTM

Bringing patient vitals to life. Founded 2011 · San Jose, California · 100,000+ patches deployed worldwide.

FDA Cleared $100M Funded

A lightweight disposable ECG patch for continuous cardiac monitoring, arrhythmia detection, and post-discharge remote patient monitoring.

What It Measures

  • Single-lead ECG
  • Heart Rate
  • Heart Rate Variability
  • Respiratory Rate
  • Activity
  • 21 Arrhythmias

Key Specifications

  • Lightweight 13g, slim & flexible disposable patch
  • No assembly or charging — fully disposable
  • IPX7 water-resistant; hypoallergenic adhesive
  • Up to 7-day wear
  • VitalCore® processor + ASIC chip

Used By & Reimbursement

  • Northwell, Hackensack, Oxford
  • CMS/Medicare cardiac codes (Holter, extended Holter, MCT)
  • Reduces acute-care costs up to 67% post-discharge

Monthly fees tied to clinical monitoring services. Reimbursed via CMS/Medicare cardiac codes.
